domains.name: seconds
domains.check: VALUE >= 0 AND VALUE = trunc(VALUE) AND VALUE::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')

domains.name: positive_integer
domains.check: VALUE > 0 AND VALUE = trunc(VALUE) AND VALUE::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')

checks.name: tombstone
checks.expression: (state = 'PRESENT' AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'DELETED' AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at >= captured_at)

checks.name: validity
checks.expression: expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > issued_at

checks.name: revision_step
checks.expression: (before_revision IS NULL AND after_revision = 1 AND before_value IS NULL) OR (before_revision IS NOT NULL AND after_revision = before_revision + 1 AND before_value IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: bootstrap
checks.expression: (revision = 1 AND last_transaction_ref IS NULL) OR (revision > 1 AND last_transaction_ref IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: meaning
checks.expression: (kind = 'UNCHANGED_VERIFICATION' AND seconds IS NULL AND batch_ref IS NOT NULL) OR (kind IN ('ACTUAL_WORK','USER_REMAINING') AND seconds IS NOT NULL AND batch_ref IS NULL)

checks.name: context
checks.expression: (context_kind IS NULL AND context_id IS NULL) OR (context_kind IS NOT NULL AND context_id IS NOT NULL AND context_kind IN ('COURSE','ACTIVITY','GOAL','EXAM'))

checks.name: ratings
checks.expression: importance BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND thinking_depth BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND repetitive_volume BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND new_learning_load BETWEEN 1 AND 5

checks.name: complete_zero
checks.expression: completion <> 'COMPLETE' OR (user_remaining_seconds IS NOT NULL AND user_remaining_seconds = 0)

checks.name: estimate_binding
checks.expression: (user_remaining_seconds IS NULL AND estimate_observation_id IS NULL AND estimate_kind IS NULL) OR (user_remaining_seconds IS NOT NULL AND estimate_observation_id IS NOT NULL AND estimate_kind IS NOT NULL AND estimate_kind = 'USER_REMAINING')

checks.name: expiring_condition
checks.expression: (requiredness = 'EXPIRING' AND expiration_condition_ref IS NOT NULL) OR (requiredness <> 'EXPIRING' AND expiration_condition_ref IS NULL)

checks.name: expiry_history
checks.expression: (disposition = 'EXPIRED' AND completion = 'INCOMPLETE' AND requiredness = 'EXPIRING' AND expiration_notice_ref IS NOT NULL AND notice_task_revision IS NOT NULL AND notice_task_revision < revision) OR (disposition <> 'EXPIRED' AND expiration_notice_ref IS NULL AND notice_task_revision IS NULL)

checks.name: release_pair
checks.expression: (release_at IS NULL AND release_original IS NULL AND release_source_record_ref IS NULL) OR (release_at IS NOT NULL AND release_original IS NOT NULL AND release_source_record_ref IS NOT NULL AND char_length(release_original) > 0)

checks.name: total_binding
checks.expression: (total_estimate_seconds IS NULL AND total_source_record_ref IS NULL AND total_observed_at IS NULL AND total_basis IS NULL AND total_definition_kind IS NULL AND total_definition_id IS NULL AND total_definition_version IS NULL) OR (total_estimate_seconds IS NOT NULL AND total_source_record_ref IS NOT NULL AND total_observed_at IS NOT NULL AND total_basis IS NOT NULL AND ((total_basis = 'USER_REPORT' AND total_definition_kind IS NULL AND total_definition_id IS NULL AND total_definition_version IS NULL) OR (total_basis = 'TEMPLATE_DEFAULT' AND total_definition_kind IS NOT NULL AND total_definition_kind IN ('TASKTYPE','TASK_TEMPLATE') AND total_definition_id IS NOT NULL AND total_definition_version IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: weight_pair
checks.expression: (weight_numerator IS NULL AND weight_denominator IS NULL) OR (weight_numerator IS NOT NULL AND weight_denominator IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: target
checks.expression: (task_id IS NULL AND task_revision IS NULL) OR (task_id IS NOT NULL AND task_revision IS NOT NULL AND action <> 'CREATE_TASK')

checks.name: review_authority
checks.expression: (review_state IN ('PENDING','CONFLICTED') AND review_authority_ref IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL) OR (review_state IN ('CONFIRMED','REJECTED') AND review_authority_ref IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at >= created_at)

checks.name: adopted_task
checks.expression: (review_state = 'CONFIRMED' AND canonical_task_ref IS NOT NULL) OR (review_state <> 'CONFIRMED' AND canonical_task_ref IS NULL)

checks.name: kind
checks.expression: (member_kind = 'TASK' AND task_ref IS NOT NULL AND task_revision IS NOT NULL AND task_ref = member_id AND task_revision = member_revision AND candidate_ref IS NULL AND candidate_revision IS NULL) OR (member_kind = 'CANDIDATE' AND candidate_ref IS NOT NULL AND candidate_revision IS NOT NULL AND candidate_ref = member_id AND candidate_revision = member_revision AND task_ref IS NULL AND task_revision IS NULL)

checks.name: explicit_submission
checks.expression: (submitted = TRUE AND user_statement_ref IS NOT NULL) OR (submitted = FALSE AND user_statement_ref IS NULL)

checks.name: accepted_active
checks.expression: active = FALSE OR acceptance_ref IS NOT NULL

checks.name: created_target
checks.expression: (state = 'CREATED' AND ((obligation_kind = 'SEPARATE_TASK' AND target_task_ref IS NOT NULL AND target_stage_ref IS NULL AND target_stage_revision IS NULL) OR (obligation_kind = 'STAGE' AND target_task_ref IS NULL AND target_stage_ref IS NOT NULL AND target_stage_revision IS NOT NULL))) OR (state <> 'CREATED' AND target_task_ref IS NULL AND target_stage_ref IS NULL AND target_stage_revision IS NULL)

checks.name: failure
checks.expression: (state = 'FAILED' AND failure_code IS NOT NULL) OR (state <> 'FAILED' AND failure_code IS NULL)

checks.name: before_endpoint
checks.expression: (before_kind = 'TASK' AND before_stage_id IS NULL AND before_stage_revision IS NULL) OR (before_kind = 'STAGE' AND before_stage_id IS NOT NULL AND before_stage_revision IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: after_endpoint
checks.expression: (after_kind = 'TASK' AND after_stage_id IS NULL AND after_stage_revision IS NULL) OR (after_kind = 'STAGE' AND after_stage_id IS NOT NULL AND after_stage_revision IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: delivery
checks.expression: (state = 'DELIVERED' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at >= started_at AND delivered_at <= finished_at) OR (state IN ('FAILED','UNKNOWN') AND delivered_at IS NULL)

checks.name: acceptance
checks.expression: (acceptance = 'DRAFT' AND acceptance_ref IS NULL) OR (acceptance = 'ACCEPTED' AND acceptance_ref IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: target_pair
checks.expression: (target_amount IS NULL AND target_unit IS NULL) OR (target_amount IS NOT NULL AND target_unit IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: workload_pair
checks.expression: (total_workload IS NULL AND workload_unit IS NULL) OR (total_workload IS NOT NULL AND workload_unit IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: progress_measure
checks.expression: (progress_measure_kind IS NULL AND progress_unit IS NULL) OR (progress_measure_kind = 'CONFIRMED_OUTCOME' AND progress_unit IS NULL) OR (progress_measure_kind = 'QUANTITY' AND progress_unit IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: known_due
checks.expression: target_due_known = TRUE OR due_ref IS NULL

checks.name: measure_pair
checks.expression: (amount IS NULL AND unit IS NULL) OR (amount IS NOT NULL AND unit IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: target_pair
checks.expression: (target_amount IS NULL AND target_unit IS NULL) OR (target_amount IS NOT NULL AND target_unit IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: acceptance
checks.expression: (acceptance = 'DRAFT' AND acceptance_ref IS NULL) OR (acceptance = 'ACCEPTED' AND acceptance_ref IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: time
checks.expression: (timing_kind = 'UNKNOWN' AND exam_date IS NULL AND event_ref IS NULL AND event_revision IS NULL) OR (timing_kind = 'DATE_ONLY' AND exam_date IS NOT NULL AND event_ref IS NULL AND event_revision IS NULL) OR (timing_kind = 'EXACT_EVENT' AND exam_date IS NULL AND event_ref IS NOT NULL AND event_revision IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: planned_ownership
checks.expression: kind <> 'PLANNED_WORK' OR (task_ref IS NOT NULL AND authority_ref IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: meaning
checks.expression: (input_kind = 'DATE_ONLY' AND original_date IS NOT NULL AND default_policy_ref IS NOT NULL AND default_timezone IS NOT NULL AND default_timezone = 'Asia/Shanghai' AND due_at = ((original_date + TIME '23:59') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')) OR (input_kind = 'EXPLICIT_INSTANT' AND original_date IS NULL AND default_policy_ref IS NULL AND default_timezone IS NULL)

checks.name: day_end
checks.expression: timezone = 'Asia/Shanghai' AND expires_at = ((((created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date + 1)::timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')

checks.name: initial_epoch
checks.expression: last_transaction_ref IS NOT NULL OR store_revision = 1

checks.name: cutoff
checks.expression: cutoff = ((((snapshot_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date + horizon_days - 1) + TIME '23:59') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')

checks.name: capacity_pair
checks.expression: (capacity_numerator IS NULL AND capacity_denominator IS NULL) OR (capacity_numerator IS NOT NULL AND capacity_denominator IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: required_pair
checks.expression: (required_numerator IS NULL AND required_denominator IS NULL) OR (required_numerator IS NOT NULL AND required_denominator IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: risk
checks.expression: risk IS NULL OR risk IN ('SAFE','DANGER','EMERGENCY')

checks.name: proof
checks.expression: placement_state NOT IN ('FEASIBLE','INFEASIBLE') OR proof_ref IS NOT NULL

checks.name: known_risk
checks.expression: risk IS NULL OR (data_quality = 'READY' AND capacity_numerator IS NOT NULL AND required_numerator IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: safe_proof
checks.expression: risk IS NULL OR risk <> 'SAFE' OR (placement_state = 'FEASIBLE' AND proof_ref IS NOT NULL AND capacity_numerator IS NOT NULL AND required_numerator IS NOT NULL AND capacity_numerator * required_denominator - required_numerator * capacity_denominator >= reserve_seconds * capacity_denominator * required_denominator)

checks.name: final_review
checks.expression: phase <> 'FINAL_EMERGENCY' OR (review_response_ref IS NOT NULL AND review_commit_ref IS NOT NULL AND recompute_ref IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: stage_pair
checks.expression: (stage_id IS NULL AND stage_revision IS NULL) OR (stage_id IS NOT NULL AND stage_revision IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: export
checks.expression: (status <> 'EXPORTED' OR exported_at IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'PENDING' OR exported_at IS NULL) AND (exported_at IS NULL OR exported_at >= created_at)

checks.name: currency
checks.expression: cost_amount IS NULL OR currency IS NOT NULL

checks.name: resolved_scope
checks.expression: (resolved_job_id IS NULL AND resolved_job_revision IS NULL) OR (resolved_job_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_job_revision IS NOT NULL AND resolved_job_id = job_id AND resolved_job_revision = job_revision)

checks.name: delivery
checks.expression: (state = 'DELIVERED' AND delivery_evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at >= created_at) OR (state <> 'DELIVERED' AND delivery_evidence_ref IS NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL)

checks.name: export
checks.expression: (status <> 'EXPORTED' OR exported_at IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'PENDING' OR exported_at IS NULL) AND (exported_at IS NULL OR exported_at <= observed_at)

conditions: OLD.state <> 'CREATED' OR (NEW.state = 'CREATED' AND NEW.target_task_ref IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.target_task_ref AND NEW.target_stage_ref IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.target_stage_ref AND NEW.target_stage_revision IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.target_stage_revision)
OLD.state <> 'DELIVERED' OR (NEW.state = 'DELIVERED' AND NEW.delivery_evidence_ref IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.delivery_evidence_ref AND NEW.delivered_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.delivered_at)
